gp/GP.meta.json.last_error: Cannot establish the configured GP source scope from 304 responses; a full response from every configured source is required.

trackedManifest.scientific_boundary: All records published in the provider SATCAT snapshot are retained; only records with validated current GP/OMM elements are propagatable. This is not an inventory of every physical debris particle.

taxonomy.lifecycle_semantics: Lifecycle and provider observation transitions are independent from element availability.
taxonomy.mission_related_source: Not independently classified by CelesTrak SATCAT; no heuristic relabeling is applied.
taxonomy.duplicate_policy: Duplicate NORAD identities are audited and resolved deterministically with the last SATCAT row winning.
taxonomy.rcs_semantics: rcs_m2 is provider-published radar cross-section, not physical object size.

provenance.gp_scope: Last-known-good GP snapshot groups: active; configured event-debris coverage remains pending a successful source-scope update.

gp_join.policy: The tracked scope is SATCAT-defined; GP-only identities remain in GP.json and are not counted twice.
